summary: StepStone Group Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the third exchange completed May 29, 2026, acquiring ~5% equity interests in each of three Asset Class Entities (SRE, SRA, SPD) from third-party sellers. The aggregate consideration was approximately $10M cash (pre-adjustment ~$11M), 972,685 shares of Class A common stock, and 2,438,273 Class D units. Post-exchange, StepStone holdings rose to 65% in each entity. Consideration based on exchange ratios tied to estimated adjusted net income and an adjusted trading multiple. Shares and units issued unregistered under Section 4(a)(2). Watch for continued step acquisitions and potential full consolidation or future registration events.
